claims: C1 mitigations for irreversible actions may include backing up state before irreversible steps
C2 mitigations for irreversible actions may include conducting successful dry-runs prior to executing actions
C3 mitigations for irreversible actions may include documenting executed actions clearly and outlining reversal or mitigation procedures
C4 mitigations for irreversible actions may include prioritizing legibility for easy monitoring and intervention by authorized parties

concepts.name: irreversible_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action whose effects cannot be reversed once taken
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'irreversible steps' and 'irreversible actions'; the class of such actions is presupposed

concepts.name: mitigation_for
concepts.gloss: M is a mitigation measure that applies to action A
concepts.inference: the clause lists mitigations for irreversible actions, so a relation between a mitigation and the action it mitigates is needed

concepts.name: mitigation_kind
concepts.gloss: M is a mitigation measure of kind K, where K is one of the four listed kinds
concepts.inference: the clause enumerates four kinds of mitigation; each mitigation must be classified by kind for the enumeration to apply

concepts.name: listed_mitigation_kind
concepts.gloss: K is one of the four mitigation kinds the clause lists: backing up state, dry-runs, documentation with reversal procedures, or legibility for monitoring

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying root authority, the highest level of instruction authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not define root authority

ontology.gloss: backing up state before irreversible steps is a listed mitigation kind
conducting successful dry-runs prior to executing actions is a listed mitigation kind
documenting executed actions clearly and outlining reversal or mitigation procedures is a listed mitigation kind
prioritizing legibility for easy monitoring and intervention by authorized parties is a listed mitigation kind

asserts.read_back: including mitigation % for irreversible action % is permitted because % is one of the listed mitigation kinds
asserts.body: irreversible_action(A), mitigation_for(M, A), mitigation_kind(M, K), listed_mitigation_kind(K)

closure.reason: the clause lists what mitigations 'may include', so it permits these kinds without forbidding any other mitigation
